svg.title: BrandGEO
svg.desc:
Horizontal combination mark. Mark left, wordmark right, separated by one stem-width of clear space.
UNBLOCKED 2026-07-31. Geist is now in the repo, so the only missing input this note described is supplied:
docs/growth/CAMPAIGN-2026-07-30/_shared/fonts/Geist-Bold.ttf (also Medium, Regular, SemiBold, plus Geist-LICENSE.txt)
From the official geist@1.7.2 npm package, Vercel, SIL OFL 1.1, so commercial use is unrestricted. Verified on install: usWeightClass 700, PIL reports the family as ('Geist','Bold'), 8 distinct advances across the 8 letters of BrandGEO, ink coverage 0.134. fontTools 4.63.0 is installed under `python` (C:\Python314), NOT under `python3`, which has neither fontTools nor PIL.
STILL TRUE, and still the reason to be careful: the wordmark below is live text, not outlined paths. It renders in a fallback face anywhere Geist is absent, and it does so SILENTLY. That is not hypothetical; it already happened once and shipped an Inter wordmark across the campaign package. Anything rasterising this file must load Geist from an explicit path so a miss raises, and must assert the result: glyph coverage in that file's own cmap, weight 700, more than one distinct advance (tofu and monospaced fallbacks collapse to one), and an ink-coverage band (0 is blank, about 0.88 is tofu boxes).
